result.topic_en: Variational calculations for the motion of a continuous medium (displacements $\eta_i$ with a Lagrange multiplier $\lambda$ and a potential $U$), together with heavily struck-through, upside-down Kurrent notes on natural-philosophical topics (space, gravitation, the medium).
result.transcription:
$\sum_{\iota'}\frac{\partial\eta_\iota'}{\partial\eta_{\iota}}d\eta_{\iota'}$ \quad $\partial_t^2(d\eta_1'd\eta_1+d\eta_2'd\eta_2+d\eta_3'd\eta_3)-(\partial_{\eta_1}^2+\partial_{\eta_2}^2+\partial_{\eta_3}^2)(d\eta_1'd\eta_1+d\eta_2'd\eta_2+d\eta_3'd\eta_3)=d^2\lambda$
$\delta\int\int\left(\frac{\partial\eta_\iota'}{\partial t}\right)^2-cc\left(\frac{\partial\eta_\iota'}{\partial\eta_1}^2+\frac{\partial\eta_\iota'}{\partial\eta_2}^2+\frac{\partial\eta_\iota'}{\partial\eta_3}^2\right)d\eta_1d\eta_2d\eta_3dt-\int\lambda\left(\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_1}+\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_2}+\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_3}\right)d\eta_1d\eta_2d\eta_3\,dt=\int\lambda\,dm\,dt-\int dm\left(\left(\frac{\partial^2\eta}{\partial t^2}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial^2\eta}{\partial t^2}\right)^2\dots\right)dt$
$\int(\eta_1'-\frac{\partial U}{\partial\eta_1})^2+(\eta_2'-\frac{\partial U}{\partial\eta_2})^2+(\eta_3'-\frac{\partial U}{\partial\eta_3})^2\,d\eta_1d\eta_2d\eta_3$
$\int(\frac{\partial\eta_\iota'}{\partial t})^2$ \quad $\left(\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_2}-\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_1}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_3}-\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_2}\right)^2\dots$

methods.what: Variational principle for a continuous medium: kinetic minus elastic energy with Lagrange multiplier enforcing incompressibility
Wave-type equation for displacements with multiplier
Least-squares deviation of a velocity field from a gradient field (potential part)
Poisson equation / Gauss law for gravitational potential relating divergence to mass
